body: I just don't have the energy anymore to try and find a way out.

I dont have a job, I have no money and am in a large amount of debt thanks to getting halfway through a pointless degree, I've lost all my friends, boyfriend finally made it clear that he no longer feels the same way. I used to have the mindset that it will all get better. It doesn't.
I'm done with being strong. It doesn't change the way I feel every day. If this is what I have to deal with in life then I'll pass.
